summary: Settings > Accounts shows a Codex account's banked rate-limit resets ("Resets available: N" and the next expiry) in place of the old reset-credits overage line, and offers "Use reset" when a window is above 85% or flagged reached and a reset is banked. An inline confirm spends one through account/rateLimitResetCredit/consume on a short-lived codex app-server with the usage read's env. Main mints the idempotency key on the click and keeps it per account until a terminal outcome, so Try again after an unknown result reuses it; the soonest-expiring credit id is passed when the list is known. Every outcome is followed by a fresh usage read. The spend channel is admin-scoped.

reactNativeIos.reason: The React Native app has no Accounts screen and never calls provider-instances:usage, so it shows no Codex usage today and has nowhere to show the count. It cannot spend a reset either: provider-instances:consume-reset is admin-scoped and a phone holds the chat scope only.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android calls provider-instances:list only and never reads usage, so it shows no Codex usage today. The spend channel is admin-scoped and refused to its chat-scoped session.

sharedBackendApi.reason: New channel provider-instances:consume-reset (admin-scoped). ProviderUsage gains an optional resetCredits field and UsageWindow an optional reached flag; the reset-credits overage row is no longer emitted. An older desktop against a newer backend shows no reset line and no button; a newer desktop against an older backend sees no resetCredits and shows neither, and the spend channel is never called.

storageDataMigration.reason: Nothing is stored: the pending idempotency key lives in main-process memory until a terminal outcome and is gone on restart. No table, setting or migration.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing, entitlement, deep link or update-channel change.

automated: tests/unit/codex-usage-parse.test.ts: rateLimitResetCredits is read into resetCredits (count, expiries from unix seconds, titles, unknown statuses, a null list), not an overage row, and the reached flag marks its window.

tests/unit/codex-reset.test.ts: outcome mapping, when Use reset is offered (critical or reached, a reset banked; at the limit after nothingToReset), the soonest-expiring credit, the expiry note, the confirm rows and the approved result copy.

tests/unit/codex-reset-consume.test.ts drives a fake codex app-server script: the key and credit id are sent, a timeout is retried once with the same key, a dead server is unknown, an unknown outcome keeps the key for the next click while a terminal one drops it and the next click mints a new one, every outcome is followed by a usage read, and a second click joins the first.
tests/unit/codex-reset-controls.test.ts (jsdom): button visibility, the inline confirm and Cancel, the locked Applying state, the result banners, Try again after unknown.
tests/unit/device-auth.test.ts: a phone is refused provider-instances:consume-reset and keeps provider-instances:usage.
